203 days from 1299-03-08.  
1299 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but not by 400 in Gregorian calendar? Actually, Gregorian calendar adopted later, but we use Gregorian arithmetic as per rules).  
1299 is not divisible by 4 → not leap.  
March has 31 days, so days left in March: 31 - 8 = 23 days.  
203 - 23 = 180 days left.  
April: 30 → 150 left.  
May: 31 → 119 left.  
June: 30 → 89 left.  
July: 31 → 58 left.  
August: 31 → 27 left.  
September: 30 → exceeds 27, so date in September: 27th.  
Thus new date: 1299-09-27.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1299-09-27
